title: Business Silver Rewards Card: Exceptions and Exclusions
summary: This document lists merchant exceptions/exclusions for the Business Silver Rewards Card: Concur, SAP Concur, Expensify, and Navan earn 1.0% (not 10.0%); Apple, Microsoft, Dell earn 1.0%; and Xbox Game Pass, PlayStation Plus, Nintendo Switch Online, Coursera, Udemy, LinkedIn Learning, Skillshare, and Pluralsight earn 1.0% instead of 10.0%.
